hypothesis: A dollar-neutral cross-sectional portfolio of liquid equities that combines 12-1/6-1/3-1 momentum, one-month reversal, low realized volatility, and dollar-volume liquidity should earn more stable risk-adjusted returns than single-signal sorts. Rebalancing only when a new month-end signal becomes available keeps turnover and costs moderate, while equal-weighting the top and bottom names with a 2% per-name cap and 1.0 gross limit keeps the book diversified and market-neutral. All signals use only point-in-time close, volume, and eligibility data available at the decision close.
